size.$description: Sizes of things (not distances between them). Primitives are steps of 0.25rem.

4.$description: Size step 4 (16px at the default root size).

5.$description: Size step 5 (20px at the default root size).

6.$description: Size step 6 (24px at the default root size).

8.$description: Size step 8 (32px at the default root size).

10.$description: Size step 10 (40px at the default root size).

48.$description: Size step 48 (192px at the default root size).

64.$description: Size step 64 (256px at the default root size).

80.$description: Size step 80 (320px at the default root size).

120.$description: Size step 120 (480px at the default root size).

192.$description: Size step 192 (768px at the default root size).

320.$description: Size step 320 (1280px at the default root size).

sm.$description: Minimum width of a narrow grid column.

md.$description: Minimum width of a standard grid column.

lg.$description: Minimum width of a wide grid column.

cell.$description: Cell size of the blueprint backdrop grid.

viewport-height.$description: Heights as a share of the dynamic viewport, as numbers. The viewport-height/dvh transform appends dvh (refinement R18.7).

image.$description: Tallest a content image gets: 80% of the dynamic viewport height, so it's seen whole.

sm.$description: Small viewport (480px at the default root size): narrower or shorter is a small screen. Media queries write it as 30em.

md.$description: Medium viewport (768px at the default root size): from here the docs side menu is a column beside the content. Media queries write it as 48em.

lg.$description: Large viewport (1280px at the default root size): from here a docs page's On this page list is a column at the inline end. Media queries write it as 80em.
